$comment: House terms a stranger cannot be expected to know. lint-post-voice.py requires each one to be defined in the SAME SENTENCE as its first use in a post's prose (a parenthetical, an appositive, or 'X is/means ...'). Chosen by measurement on 2026-09-20 across the 40 most recent posts; ordinary engineering words (manifest, worktree, mutation, runbook, Caddy) are deliberately absent so the rule does not cry wolf. 'hint' is a suggested gloss of twelve words or fewer, shown in the lint message. Add a term only when it means something HERE that it does not mean elsewhere.

terms.hint: a tracked task record in the repo's issue database
a parent task that groups related work items
a machine-written record proving a step really ran
every repo, server and service the company runs
a scheduled job that checks other jobs are still alive
the script that commits and publishes; the model never touches git
set a failed run's files aside instead of publishing them
a hash record of exactly what passed the gates
an opinionated Arch Linux desktop setup by DHH
the company's internal operations and documentation repo
each repo's numbered folder of dated records
the company's audited, citation-backed knowledge base
a seven-seat adversarial review council of AI personas
the in-repo package of deterministic test-quality checks
